==About==

{{i|Scuttling Crab Legs}} is received by chance when cracking open a {{i|Crab}} with {{i|Any Stone}}. Scuttling Crab Legs is a minor [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Crustacea and Shellfish}} Food Group.
